name: relate-example-03-wasm-agent-memory
description: Example 03: the Relate playground as an agent's memory. A scripted chat writes memories into Relate 1.2.0 WASM and recalls them with vector search (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), full-text search and graph hops, drawn with NVL with the recalled paths highlighted. Install with `npm ci --omit=peer`; `npm run build` writes dist/.
